title: Non-atomic write in update_last_message_at loses chat changes
description: update_last_message_at runs 'UPDATE chats SET last_message_at = ?' outside any transaction, commits it, then opens a second transaction to advance the state counter and write changed_at_counter. A process crash between the two writes leaves last_message_at updated but changed_at_counter stale. The chat then never appears in Chat/changes until the next modification. Fix: wrap both the initial UPDATE and the counter/changed_at_counter write in a single transaction.
